title: THIN, cheap, but soft. It's okay.
text:
THIN, cheap, but soft. It's okay.. Good and bad on this one.

The bad:
The backing is VERY thin fabric. Think the tops of dollar store Christmas stockings. Very thin, but has a tiny nap on it. I took a picture with a dollar store flat flashlight showing through TWO layers.
Also, it is not attached anywhere but the outer seams. You'd expect a few seams through the middle areas so it doesn't shift, but nope. This is just two pieces of fabric sewn together on the outer edges. That's it.

The good:
The furry part (the "top") is very soft and has a great feel to it. Again, a lightweight fabric, but it has a longer nap and makes for a nice throw.

They sent me the wrong color, but I was okay with the one sent, so not returning it. I actually got it as an extra blanket for our cats, but it is nice enough for an extra chair or loveseat throw too.

I'd buy it again if the price is right.
